errors.evidence: The numerical labels on the y-axis are at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60, indicating intervals of 10 billion Euros, not 5.
The chart displays 11 bars, one for each year from 2015 to 2025 inclusive.

errors.text_span: der längste Balken für das Jahr 2023
errors.evidence: The longest bar in the chart corresponds to the year 2022, with a total value of approximately 54 billion Euro. The bar for 2023 is visibly shorter, at approximately 52 billion Euro.

errors.text_span: wobei „Innere Sicherheit“ den größten Teil des Balkens ausmacht
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that 'Innere Sicherheit' (purple segment) makes up the largest part of the bar for 2023. In reality, for every year shown, the blue segment ('Äußere Sicherheit') is by far the largest component of the bar.
